tiny_findings.conclusion: The error conflates any SIGIO and any lease-state change with an external reader. The controlled reproduction exposes a lease lifecycle assumption after alias replacement; external reader presence is unproven.
tiny_findings.B_phase: Actual B stat equals prepared fields. Original source checks all leases before linking B, so prior A target lease break can stop B before any B namespace change.

small_fix_proposal_only.proposal: Treat leases as owned resources per inode. Keep retained best leases active; immediately before atomic replacement explicitly retire, close and remove only the outgoing last inode descriptor from the active lease and cleanup sets. Never globally ignore SIGIO.
small_fix_proposal_only.tiny_validation: Five isaaclab combined A/B fixtures passed with no SIGIO and exact bytes, test02. The first proposal double-unlocked a retired fd and failed cleanup, preserved as test01.
small_fix_proposal_only.limitation: A reader racing after outgoing lease retirement may retain the immutable old identical inode; immediate space recovery is not guaranteed. Requires new source identity and independent root review before any real B-only continuation.
